summary: Phase 2 testing: 23/23 backend pytest passed (areas, roles, permissions, leaves with hierarchy enforcement, targets, batch sync, GPS track + live). Frontend Tenant Admin pages (Areas, Roles, Targets, Leaves, Employees Add) all working with proper data-testids, modals open, seeded data visible. Employee PWA: target card and Tracking-GPS status work; Leaves tile is present BUT clicking it navigates to /app/notifications instead of /app/leaves.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the Leaves tile on Employee home navigates to /t/demo/app/notifications instead of /t/demo/app/leaves. The data-testid='card-leaves' element has the wrong link/onClick handler (likely the leaves card uses the notifications route).

action_items: Fix Employee Home Leaves tile (data-testid=card-leaves) routing — it currently navigates to /app/notifications. Update the Link 'to' or onClick handler in /app/frontend/src/pages/Employee/Home.jsx so the Leaves card opens /t/{slug}/app/leaves.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1747 lines — consider splitting Phase 2 endpoints (areas, roles, leaves, targets, sync, gps) into routers/ submodules for maintainability.
PATCH /api/areas ignores parent_id changes — moving a node in the tree is not supported (path won't update). OK for MVP but document the limitation.

_is_in_hierarchy_above walks the chain via manager_id loops with visited set — good, but tenant_admin override happens before chain walk, which is correct; consider adding role='super_admin' bypass for symmetry if SA ever decides leaves.

batch sync /api/sync/batch does not dedupe on client_id — repeated submissions with same client_id will create duplicate records. Add lookup against an idempotency table or store client_id on each record.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md — Tenant Admin 9000000001, Manager 9000000002, Employee 9000000003, Employee2 9000000005; OTP 123456 / tenant 'demo'. Super Admin 9858558555 OTP 557725.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users, areas, roles, leaves and clean them up via DELETE endpoints. A TEST_Emp Updated and TEST_RoleArea may persist from prior iteration; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 backend is solid (23/23 pytest pass) including hierarchy-based leave approval (403 for non-chain managers), GPS clustering, sync batch with mixed types, targets progress, role permission overlay. Frontend Tenant Admin pages all good (Areas tree shows 8 seeded nodes, Roles modal exposes perm-{module}-read/write toggles, Targets shows Anil/Priya rows with per-row save, Employees Add modal exposes 'Custom Role' and 'Area Assignment' selects). The one real bug found: Employee Home Leaves tile (card-leaves) navigates to /app/notifications. After fix, re-test by logging in as 9000000003 and clicking the Leaves tile — it should go to /t/demo/app/leaves and show the Apply button + existing pending TEST_403 / approved TEST_leave from this test run. Employee Check-In already started during testing — 'Tracking GPS' status is visible on Home and target card shows ₹300/₹55,000 = 0.5%.
rca of the issue: Likely a copy-paste in Employee/Home.jsx where the Leaves card uses the wrong route prop (probably reused the Notifications card's 'to' prop). Inspect the JSX for data-testid='card-leaves' and confirm its Link/href points to `/t/${slug}/app/leaves` (not `/notifications`).
